decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter sits close to the firm's curing and salami know-how and is presented as a flagship of its organic direction, so the firm can read early results and refine the line.

The premium salami snack line builds directly on the firm's salami expertise and was expanded with a poultry variant in 2024, which suggests the firm is learning from results, though its prominence on the website declined.
The organic Fleischwurst is a traditional product the firm knows well, made in organic quality, which fits the strategic organic expansion and is easy to assimilate.

The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line extends the firm's cold-cut competence and has several variants; snack-like formats carry some risk, as the withdrawn poultry snack shows, but the product is close enough to existing knowledge to keep.
The organic herb-coated salami draws on the firm's in-house seasoning and maturation expertise and its organic focus, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
